scan_max.description: The most rows one question reads before it pages (`stats` says `truncated` above it).

traverse_nodes.description: `max_nodes` of one traversal (`dependents`, each half of `path`), at most 5000.

description.purpose: Answers the cross questions of the space from its store alone -- `resolve`, `callers`, `dependents`, `deps`, `path`, `similar`, `broken`, `stats` -- one store bundle each, every list a page, every answer counting the broken edges it touched. Every answer sees the question's round (`context.audience_now`, else `context.audience_set`): an object hive's source (`ob-`) only when its round covers the question's, never without a round -- its nodes, the edges from and to it, the `resolve` hits, the paths through it and the counters fall away, and a question about a hidden address is answered as one about an unknown one.
description.use_when: Inside a graph space only, behind `in_graph`.
description.not_in_scope: No write, no message to a source, no content of a source.
description.emits_meaning: `query_store` to `./store` once per question, `answer` once per question.
description.consumes_meaning: A question on `in_graph` (its round in the context), and the store's answer to its one bundle.
